about: A huge pack wolf; it howls to its pack and snarls as they hunt together.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A large wolf howls a long mournful howl, two separate howls with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large wolf barks sharply and snarls in alarm, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large wolf yelps in pain, five separate yelps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large wolf whimpers weakly and goes silent, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A large wolf snarls and snaps its jaws in a vicious bite, five separate bites with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Paws of a large wolf trotting on earth: light quick padded steps, separate bursts. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
